title: Best Guide - Adrian
text: Absolutely amazing day with Adrian.  He was the best guide we had on our trip.  He had incredible information (historic and present) safe driver, very friendly and patient with our foursome of all ages.  Adrian is very well spoken ( in English for us)....loud enough, clear words with authentic accent.
author: R2423ZZsusand

title: Fantastic tour of Barcelona!
text: Adrian was a fantastic tour guide!  He made this tour very informative and fun!  He is very knowledgeable of the history of Barcelona  - this was a fantastic way to start a few day visit to a beautiful city!
author: Companion521825

title: 10/10 experience
text: We had a great experience with Adrian. Explored a lot of Barcelona in 8 hours. We had a great experience and would highly recommend!
author: Kelcee S

title: Barcelona in 1 Day with Adrian
text:
Adrian - was a fantastic guide with a very entertaining conversational style that really brought added value to our tour.   He knew many, many stories/history related to every site we saw.   His driving/parking skills were on point as we eased through the traffic congestion.  
We really enjoyed our time with Adrian. 
Thank you!!
author: marcmI9718BZ

title: An Excellent Day with Adrien
text: Our family of six adults spent a terrific day with Adrien! He was professional, extremely knowledgeable, thoughtful and endlessly cheerful. He was a safe driver with the pickup/drop off and travels in between going smoothly. The day was perfectly paced with sufficient time at all the sites we wanted to see, and breaks to get out of the heat. We can not recommend Adrien highly enough!!
author: MapleLeafGirl774

title: An excellent experience with Adrien
text: Our family of six adults spent a day with Adrien; he was professional, knowledgeable, thoughtful and delightfully cheerful. He managed the time well, with breaks out of the heat and consideration for a less mobile family member. He was a careful driver and our pick up/drop off went smoothly. We could not recommend Adrien more highly.
author: MapleLeafGirl774

title: Studying Barcelona
text: This is not our first time in Barcelona, but this time we decided to take a full-day tour with Adrian. It was the best decision. A very comfortable tour with full accompaniment. We delved into the city's history, visited the most significant locations, and received a lot of useful recommendations. We highly recommend Adrian and his tours.
author: Steve N

title: Barcelona in a day and memories forever
text: Adrian is an outstanding guide.  He was generous with his time and his knowledge and passion for Barcelona were formidable.  He shared precious photos and images with us to reinforce the information he had shared and these will provide a lifetime of memories from a very special day and a magnificent city.  Barcelona is a city of secrets - the revelation is the real magic!  Thank you Adrian.
author: CatherineCarbajal

title: An Unforgettable Day with Adrian in Barcelona
text:
Our private tour of Barcelona with Adrian was one of the absolute highlights of our trip to Spain. From the moment we met him, it was clear we were in great hands. He was incredibly knowledgeable, engaging, and passionate about Barcelona’s history, architecture, and culture, and he brought every stop to life with fascinating stories and context.
